tasks.title: Wrong functional dependency in ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY mode

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 已有可操作场景、输入与可观察对照；纳入探索队列不等于确认目标版本受影响。

test_spec.setup: 按评论实际表结构建立t1(a,b,c)两行(1,1,1),(2,1,1)，t2(a)三行1,2,1；开启ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY。
test_spec.steps: 分别开关subquery_to_derived执行GROUP BY b但子查询引用t1.a的COUNT查询。
test_spec.oracle: t1.a不由b唯一决定；两优化配置应一致拒绝非法分组，不能因转换返回任意计数。
requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标8.0支持所述SQL/功能；是否仍存在该异常须在各目标版本实测。

explicit_requirements: 保存完整SQL、配置、输出与错误日志

comments.text:
mysql> SET optimizer_switch='subquery_to_derived=on';
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select * from t1;
+------+------+------+
| a    | b    | c    |
+------+------+------+
|    1 |    1 |    1 |
|    2 |    1 |    1 |
+------+------+------+
2 rows in set (0.05 sec)

mysql> select * from t2;
+------+
| a    |
+------+
|    1 |
|    2 |
|    1 |
+------+
3 rows in set (0.05 sec)

mysql> SET optimizer_switch='subquery_to_derived=on';
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select b, (select count(t.a) from t2 as t where t.a = t1.a) as c from t1 group by b;
+------+---+
| b    | c |
+------+---+
|    1 | 2 |
+------+---+
1 row in set (0.12 sec)

mysql> select b, (select count(t.a) from t2 as t where t.a = t1.a) as c from t1;
+------+---+
| b    | c |
+------+---+
|    1 | 2 |
|    1 | 1 |
+------+---+
2 rows in set (0.11 sec)
